notes: This book appears to be a compilation or activity resource about multiple well-known children's book characters (Pete the Cat, The Very Hungry Caterpillar, Where the Wild Things Are, Rainbow Fish, The Gruffalo, etc.). The fringe vocabulary has been chosen to span the most commonly referenced characters and themes across the genre rather than one specific narrative. Several character-specific images already exist in activity_images/ (e.g. pete_the_cat, hungry_caterpillar, grouchy_ladybug, gruffalo, rainbow_fish, curious_george, cat_in_hat, wild_things_are) and these should be considered for supplementary visual supports on the board or as companion cards. The hero slot should use a collage or the most prominent character from the actual book cover — verify with the teacher which character is most recognisable to their students.
